environment: Node test runner, python3 -I, scratch git repos in the OS temp dir

cases.title: No script reads a slice's branch field
cases.given: A repo with 3 slices; branch field set to each corpus value, to non-string values, or removed
cases.when: next-action.py, state-write.py (patch-slice, status) and janitor.py run
cases.then: Outputs, state, refs and files equal the original run
cases.expected: identical apart from the branch field

evidence.title: run summary
evidence.inline: 149 tests, 149 pass, 0 fail. Corpus: 12 families plus 13 non-string/huge values (1 MB string, null, number, list, object, nested list).

evidence.title: no side effect
evidence.inline: Per variant: slices.json (branch/commit keys stripped), git refs, STATUS.md, and the parent directory listing equal the original run. No traversal path created a file outside the repo.

attacks.charter: Explore slice state scripts with garbage branch values to find a read of the branch field (R-061)

attacks.observed: identical to original in every case
